text.tspan: tools/list → 36 core tools; the extension lookup finds FroshTools and adds frosh_health,
No, the platform is the problem, not the shop data. No worker has been seen on the async
queue: 134 messages are waiting, the oldest for almost ten days, among them 75 thumbnail
jobs and 49 index updates. That is exactly your missing thumbnails and stale search. The
scheduled tasks are overdue by the same margin, so nothing runs in the background at all.
Also: PHP has no memory limit set (FroshTools wants 512M) and MySQL lacks time zone tables.
Dependencies are clean: no known advisories in 201 packages.
Start a message worker (or the cron for it) first; the queue will drain and both symptoms
disappear. The memory limit is a php.ini change. I cannot start workers from here.
